cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this invitation?
cancelConfirm.body: {{name}}'s link will stop working. Anything they already recorded is kept.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete everything about this candidate?
deleteConfirm.body: {{name}}'s recordings, transcript, analysis and documents will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid_email: That is not a valid email address.
errors.too_many_candidates: Invite at most 100 people at a time.
errors.project_not_active: Publish the role before inviting candidates.
errors.session_closed: This interview is already finished, cancelled or expired.
errors.address_undeliverable: This address bounced or marked our email as spam. Invite the candidate again with a corrected address.
errors.site_url_not_configured: The site address is not configured, so invitation links cannot be built.
errors.rate_limited: That is a lot of invitations at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.insufficient_role: Only admins, owners and the role’s creator can copy a candidate’s link.
